def plan(waypoints, held=None, every=3, ignore=()):
    pv = ep.preview(waypoints)
    qs = pv["q"][::every] + [pv["q"][-1]] if pv.get("q") else []
    chk = ep.check_batch(qs, held=held, ignore=ignore) if qs else []
    bad = [(i*every, [(x["link"], x["obstacle"], round(x["clearance_m"],3)) for x in c["contacts"]]) for i, c in enumerate(chk) if not c["collision_free"]]
    print("preview ok", pv["ok"], "|", rh.explain(pv), "| duration", pv.get("duration"), "min", pv.get("min_duration"), "| n q", len(pv.get("q", [])), "| colliding samples", len(bad), bad[:4])
